notes.title: 【Update Note】Spring Sale Coming! v1.7.5 Update & Optimization
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Loopstructor experts, we will also release new discounts in this spring sale. Welcome to purchase and play! 

We are also pleased to bring you the update of v1.7.5, which includes a series of experience optimizations and bug fixes, aiming to bring you a better and smoother gaming experience.
[/b]
[h2]Experience optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] The unlocking order of Monster Main Base has been moved forward: We have adjusted the unlocking requirement of Monster Main Base from completion difficulty 20 to completion difficulty 16. Everyone can unlock earlier and use Monster Main Base to challenge higher difficulty.
[*] Achievement data synchronization: Achievement data related to the cumulative number of kills has now been synchronized with the kill data in the atlas.
[*] Pictorial interface optimization: When entering the game, the help interface jump button in the lower left corner will be restored.
[*] Main menu refreshed: The main menu interface restores the classic style.
[*] Super Module Improvement: The super module scattering projectile has been optimized, removing the restriction that new shells do not have elemental effects. Now, you can fully unleash elemental power and create more genre combinations in battle. It also fixed the issue where the "acceleration" collaborative module in the shell tank group could not take effect.
[/list]
[h2]Bug fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pick-up train interaction issue: Fixed the issue where the ejection prompt was left on the field due to pick-up train interaction under specific conditions.
[*] Bullet locking issue: Fixed the issue where new shells created by scattering projectiles would lock onto friendly units.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems or have any suggestions during the game, please join the  Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz]https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz[/url] for feedback.
Wish you a happy gaming experience!

notes.title: v1.7.0 Update Notes: Sweetie Lychee Remake & Translation Optimization
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Players! 
The Steam Winter Sale is about to start, and we will also carry out a regular update!
This update mainly optimizes the quality of text description and translation that was not standardized in the past, and also optimizes the growth experience of new players. [/b]

The following is the updated content: 

[h2]New content[/h2]
In order to enhance the ability of long-range AOE attack, "Ballista" Synergy Module has been added for "Sweetie Lychee", and the attack animation has also been changed to fire "Piercing Arrow". 

[h2]Experience Optimization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized the description text format and translation quality of all Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese, making it clearer and easier to read.
[*] Include changing "Energy Catapult" to "Energy Launcher","Catapult" to "Node","Super Module" to "Powerful Module","Field Domain" to "Field" and so on.
[*] Optimized the unlocking experience of Powerful Module during the play of new players, which will better match the currently owned vehicles and main base. 
[*] Adjusted the numerical growth after the upgrade of Monster vehicles. 
[*] Removed the "Crit" Synergy Module and bomb attack animation of "Sweetie Lychee". 
[*] The attack animation of the Powerful Module "Jet Booster" was changed from "Bomb" to "Piercing Arrow". 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the leaderboard could not correctly read the player's Steam name when playing the shared game from the Steam family group. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the vehicle icon in the centre panel sometimes followed the mouse incorrectly, and the mouse could not interact normally.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems during the game, please join our Discord server for feedback.
Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz]https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz[/url]

notes.title: 《Loopstructor》v1.6.3 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone's timely feedback, we have found the root cause of some urgent issues discovered after the v1.6.0 update and completed the update. We hope you have a great weekend gaming, and if you encounter any other problems, feel free to join our Discord server to provide feedback.

[h1]Issue Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Fixed the problem that new players could not load their vehicles and start the game normally after completing the tutorial.
[*]  Fixed the issue where the higher the player's DPS, the more severe the game stuttering due to the logic related to "Spike".
[*]  Fixed the performance issue of the "Monster" series vehicles caused by special effects error reporting.
[*]  Fixed the problem that the battle wave could not end normally due to damage value overflow.
[*]  Fixed an issue where the IDs of some players in the leaderboard were not uploaded correctly.
[/list]

If you encounter any problems during the game, please join our Discord server for feedback.
Discord:[url=https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz]https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz[/url]

notes.title: The Ultimate Update! End Game & Massive Optimizations is coming!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! The ultimate update has been officially launched. It brings deeper strategic depth to "Loopstructor", adds many enhancement modules for various genres, and adds a powerful final boss on the highest difficulty -20!
[previewyoutube=sZPigF_oYN0;full][/previewyoutube]
We will also launch a one-week limited-time 10% discount! It's a good time to buy games!

In addition, there are a lot of game experience optimizations and improvements to the overall game balance. Here are the key points of all the changes.

Thank you very much to all the players who conducted game testing in advance for the update of "Loopstructor". Without your hard testing, we would not have been able to release the game update smoothly![/b]

[h1]New Contents:[/h1]
- Classic Mode: Add Ultimate Difficulty 20, pass Difficulty 20 with any Main Base to unlock Ultimate Difficulty 20, which will add a new boss 'Monster Train'.

- New initial Main Base: Monster Main Base. (Unlocked by killing the Monster Train boss on difficulty 20).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/963202186e4b038e986603d41041a9db471c63d4.png[/img]
- Add a new series of vehicles with 'Monster' Orbital Vehicle Synergy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/17ec6fd337c154849ee9370cb6b014480ebff16f.png[/img]
- Add dozens of new Super Modules.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/f1c135dbff8ea568955a6f451f85fad3de6e6a97.png[/img]
- Add various new Immediate Orders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/f3d6973b0f41a1144a32169b6103ebd782c9c1eb.png[/img]
- New mode 'Monthly Challenge' and Monthly Challenge Leaderboard.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/e839043e6141cba27ce7f5a833d28c46a20d4f7d.png[/img]

[h1]Feature Optimisation:[/h1]
- When the game drops frames, the game rate will be automatically reduced to avoid losing damage judgments.

- Optimised the size of damage words.

- Adjusted the damage of 'Explode' to a percentage of damage based on the enemy's HP. 

- The numeric of the main base that can be enhanced by the "Support" Vehicle can be viewed in the pop-up window or illustration.

- Added a 'ReRandom' button to the initial screen of Random Mode.

- An additional Super Module can be obtained randomly before the start of Random Mode.

- Optimised the battle mechanics of vehicles related to 'Summon' and 'Channel' synergy.

- Optimised the visual effect of the interaction of the 'Explosive Ejection' Super Module.

- Optimised the visual effects of Shockwave.

- The Boss 'Baneling King' will move towards the Main Base for a certain distance before storing up its power when it enters the second stage.

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed the issue where the game would occupy more memory.

- Fixed a series of interaction issues with the Centre Panel.

- Fixed the issue that sometimes the number of selectable vehicles was abnormal when picking vehicles rewards.

- Reduced the lagging of the game in special situations.


[b]If you encounter any problems, you can join our Discord for feedback!
[url=https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz]https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz[/url][/b]

notes.title: Loopstructor v1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Dear Loopstructor players
We are pleased to announce that we have released our first content update, version 1.2.0! This update adds a lot of playable content, as well as listening to the community's feedback to optimise the game's interactive experience, and adds a lot of new and convenient features, so players are welcome to continue to play the Loop!
Please feel free to join our community and provide feedback and suggestions to the developers!
The major updates for v1.2.0 are as follows:

[b]New Playable Content[/b]
Opened the highest challenge difficulty to 15 levels
Added 'Blast Main Base' and a series of vehicles related to Blast Super Modules and related Super Modules.
Added 'Melee Main Base' and a series of vehicles related to Melee Main Base and related Super Modules.
Added 'Yin-Yang Main Base' and related Super Modules.
Added two new types of monsters that appear in Elite Waves.

[b]Functional optimisation[/b]
Added 'Track Adjust Mode' function.
Added 'Vehicles Adjust Mode' function.
Added 'Recycle' function.
Added 'One Click Merge' function.
Optimised the performance of vehicles related to drones, and improved the frame rate of the game on all devices.
Enhanced the attack ability of the main base
Optimised the refreshing mechanism of the Orbital Vehicle Synergy ,making it easier for players to get vehicles that match the type of the main base.
Fixed a large number of known bugs

[b]New Content Testing[/b]
The test branch of the new mode 'Random Challenge Mode' will be opened on the 19th of August in a small scale, players who want to test the new mode in advance can DM the administrator in Discord to get the qualification for test access, and welcome to the developers to give feedback suggestions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/b4a596598c16f3cbbbe0b4d5574342fb6be111e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859618/395ca7e5f5242d9eb0416d724f2011ae1f1b8865.png[/img]

We thank you for your support and continued feedback, and look forward to keeping you all entertained with our first big update! We also welcome all players to join our community to provide continuous updates and feedback on Loopstructor!
Disord：https://discord.gg/TJqVnDErNz

Pone Games

notes.title: Loopstructor Update Roadmap Release!
notes.notes:
Dear loop constructors:
  After 4 days of release, "Loopstructor" has received "Very Positive" from players. [b]Thank you to all players for your love and support. We will continue to update and bring more interesting new content for you![/b]
  Loopstructor is the first officially released game by our development team. Due to the lack of experience in making and publishing games officially, we encountered many problems after its launch. Currently, the overall game status has returned to stability, [b]but it is also very necessary for everyone to join our community, provide feedback for the game[/b], and let us understand where further polishing and optimization are needed!
  [b]We are ready to release 2 major updates within a month after release[/b], and fix bugs and optimize the gaming experience based on everyone's feedback. In addition, we are also testing many new contents and will launch them later.
  The following roadmap lists the currently determined update route, and we will also adjust our update plan appropriately based on your feedback!

notes.title: New Demo of Loopstructor Join Steam Next Fest！ Demo Version 0.82 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Hello players! Thank you all for your love and support for our game Loopstructor! We're very excited to announce that Loopstructor will be participating in the Steam Next Fest starting June 10th, and we've brought a major update to the demo version!
Thanks to a lot of feedback from players, we've further improved the playability and gameplay experience of the demo version, and added some very interesting new content. We welcome more players to join our official Discord server to provide more feedback! Your feedback and suggestions are very important to us!
Below are the highlights of the trial version 0.82:

Content Iteration
1. Added a very detailed new player tutorial (really detailed).
2. Added a variety of new Immediate Order, including " Parry Strike" to smash enemies flat, and "Overclock" to make your Vehicles start spinning. 
3. Updated most of the game's UI, including the Reward UI, Finish UI, etc., as well as a brand new Start Interface. 
4. Updated the initial Supermodule of chain cars to "Conductive Stick". 
5. Optimized the operation feeling of dragging and dropping the Catapult vehicle.
6. Fixed rewards have been changed to two choices, which can be used immediately after selection. Adjusted the "Free Catapult" to Immediate Order with a probability of dropping. 
7. Optimized the pathfinding and behavior of the Spider Queen, and a big health bar will appear.
8. Added the UI for the guide when the vehicle is dragged back to the backpack.
9. Splitting two Trains of Vehicles can now create a larger field.
Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the problem that the cannonballs summoned by "Auxiliary Bombardment" sometimes can't hit the monsters. 
2. Optimized the problem that the game would become very laggy when there are a lot of monsters in the later stages.
Numerical Adjustments
1. Increased the overall difficulty of the game. 
2. Slightly accelerated the trajectory speed of the Lobber Vehicle. 
3. Increased the radius of the monster spot, monsters will now become more sparse.
